key_information_units.information: Net revenue reached SEK 3,963 million in 2025, up 11.3% from SEK 3,562 million in 2024, with growth driven primarily by the Nordics segment.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures table: Net revenue 3,963 vs 3,562; growth 11.3%; Nordics net sales 3,699.8 (12.0% growth, 93.4% of total).

key_information_units.information: EBIT declined to SEK 78.2 million (2.0% margin) from SEK 117.4 million (3.3% margin) in 2024; net result SEK -3 million vs SEK 21 million; gross margin fell to 41.9% from 44.0%.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures: EBIT 78.2 (2.0%) vs 117.4 (3.3%); gross profit 1,659 (41.9%) vs 1,569 (44.0%); net result -3 vs 21.

key_information_units.information: Nordics (93.4% of sales) grew 12.0% to SEK 3,699.8 million; Europe sales declined 1.3% to SEK 130.7 million, leading to reorganization and office closures.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Segment reporting and management report: Nordics 3,699.8 (EBIT 368.3); Europe 130.7 (EBIT -26.7); reorganization details.

key_information_units.information: New automated warehouse expansion in Vansbro went live in 2025 (~SEK 500 million investment, largest project); capacity up to 100,000 orders per day, full operation expected early 2026.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Highlights, CEO statement, and warehouse section: live in 2025, 100,000 orders/day capacity, SEK 500 million investment, ramp-up and full operation timing.

key_information_units.information: First Fab Store (500 m² scalable concept) opened in Täby Centrum in late 2025; additional openings: third store in Finland (Espoo) and fifth in Norway (Stavanger).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Highlights and selected events: Fab Store in Täby (October/November), Espoo Finland, Stavanger Norway; concept as blueprint.

key_information_units.information: Own brands expanded with relaunch of Make Up Store and launch of Scandinavian Soap Factory; portfolio continues to grow and supports margin improvement.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Own brands section, highlights, and CEO statement: Make Up Store relaunch, Scandinavian Soap Factory launch; growth noted.

key_information_units.information: Cash flow from operating activities rose to SEK 528 million from SEK 210 million in 2024; net debt (excl. IFRS 16) reduced to SEK 292 million from SEK 333 million.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Key figures and cash flow statement: operating cash flow 528 vs 210; net debt 292 vs 333.

key_information_units.information: Post-period: cost savings programme announced for ~SEK 100 million annual savings (~70 positions, SEK 22 million restructuring cost in Q1 2026); credit facilities extended to 2028.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Events after year-end: Trading Update details on savings programme, positions, cost, and RCF extension to 2028.

key_information_units.information: Over 350,000 new customers in Q4 2025; strengthened brand awareness (top of mind for every other Swedish woman) and market share gains amid industry challenges.
key_information_units.source_evidence: CEO statement: 350,000+ Q4 customers; 'every other Swedish woman has Lyko top of mind'; market share gains noted.
